name: Khemet Suncrown
loreTies: Sacred order channels solar power into civilization.
Solar Law: coordinated Deities gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
Khemet Suncrown is a colossal Aten Ra deity shaped by sacred order channels solar power into civilization. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Khemet Suncrown is the Realm’s Khepri engine: the force that rolls dead light into dawn and turns Nile-black memory into power. Human scarab amulets are miniature echoes of his living renewal shell. He feeds allies by converting wounds, offerings, and battlefield heat into measured solar return.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Khemet Suncrown began as more than a weapon in The Golden Dominion of Aten. Khemet Suncrown was bound to a solar pylon during a Gate disturbance that tested whether sacred order channels solar power into civilization could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Deity chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Aten Ra, Khemet Suncrown is treated as proof that a divine solar civilization of judgment, radiance, command, sacred order, temple law, and ancient solar mathematics can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms, but their real identity is tactical: defensive command, radiant control, judgment zones, solar sustain. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Khemet Suncrown; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Deity to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Khemet Suncrown survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever judgment zones appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Khemet Suncrown gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-deity Deity, Khemet Suncrown turns Solar Law from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Khemet Suncrown's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 34, attack 9, range 3, speed 2, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Mesha and other Codex witnesses can interpret their Gate scar.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
mythicSource: Khepri + Black Land fertility + solar renewal
visualCanon: Massive renewal-battery deity with scarab-inspired carapace plates, faience and lapis inlay reservoirs, papyrus-green conduit veins, black Nile-silt glass core, dawn-gold crown, and slow rotating solar arcs behind the shoulders. Avoid insect monster; he is a divine generator of rebirth with clear anatomy and ceremonial mass.
